id: Re-Degradation Reveals Resolution | CVPR 2027 | addendum v2 | registered after run 1 and before run 2
scope: Frozen v1.0 and every R/F/M rule stay exactly as registered and are re-evaluated on run 2. The addendum only adds estimators, real-shift pairs and the rules below; it changes no v1.0 constant, step or threshold.
motivation: run 1: the gain of ATC@s_hat concentrates where the shift is blur
run 1: the v1.0 joint blur+noise fit fails under sensor noise, while the v1.1 tail fit recovers (s, sigma)
run 1: on real cross-dataset shifts ATC@s_hat equals ATC and trails COTT
run 1: the real 25 -> 50 cm change is flagged, because it is a resampling, not a Gaussian blur

plugin.COT_m: acc_src(level) + COT_err_src(level) - COT_err_target: the COT error calibrated on A2 degraded to the identified level
plugin.COTT_m: COTT threshold calibrated on A2 degraded to the identified level (true A2 labels), applied to the target
plugin.level: v1.0 level for the *_m columns; v2 level for the *_v2 columns

v2_path.flagged: v1.1 tail fit (s_v11, sigma_v11) replaces the v1.0 joint fit
v2_path.noise_model_check: one-sided Mann-Whitney U (greater): target knee-fit SSE vs the SSE of A2 simulated at (s_v11, sigma_v11) with fresh Gaussian noise; a v2 flag needs both checks to fire
v2_path.primary_v2: ATC_v2 = ATC calibrated on A2 at the v2 level

gsd.chain: heat blur Delta (25 cm px^2) -> 2x2 area downsample to 50 cm -> 8-bit rounding -> PIL bicubic x2 upsample (the target's own resampling); the GSD ratio 2 comes from the image metadata
gsd.Delta: label-free knee matching of the chain on A2 over CHAIN_GRID = {0} U geomspace(0.05, 64, 20)

fresh_data: seeds 1-2 of ucm, whu_rs19, optimal31, clrs and the two PatternNet pairs were never run before this addendum; every addendum rule is also reported on that fresh subset

P1.test: X@s_hat < X, one-sided Wilcoxon on paired cells, Holm over the 6 pairs

P3.test: non-inferiority: upper 95% bound of the pooled paired difference X@s_hat - X <= +1.0 pp (hierarchical bootstrap)

P4.regime: real pairs with added blur (real_plus4, real_plus16)
P4.test: X@s_hat < X, one-sided Wilcoxon on paired cells

N2.test: ATC_v2 vs the strongest baseline of the regime, one-sided Wilcoxon on paired cells

G1.comparison: MAE of ATC_g vs ATC_s and ATC over the 6 encoders

S2.status: EXCEEDED / MATCHED / BELOW from the hierarchical 95% CI of (ATC_v2 - strongest baseline of the regime)
